verdict_basis: No consumer of worktree-registration state exists in either lane or anywhere in the fleet, so the registrations' disappearance cannot change any checkout behaviour. (a) No active git hook: both hooks dirs contain only *.sample files, core.hooksPath is unset in both repos and at global/system scope, and no non-sample hook file exists in any fleet lane. (b) No worktree-based gate: the fleet-wide sweep for an actual `git worktree` INVOCATION returns ZERO matches; the assignment's own command finds `worktree list` in exactly 2 files and both are historical prose .md reports, not scripts. (c) Both prose callers already recommend the very cleanup being performed and require nothing to persist. Caveat carried forward (not a blocker): both owning lanes are dirty/unpushed — see lane_state_gate.

notes: GO on pruning all 21 registrations. No git hook, no worktree-based gate script, and no live surface in either lane consumes the registration state — the assignment's two hypotheses are both falsified by direct sweep, not by absence of evidence.

The two prose callers are not obstacles but collaborators: r80-baseline.md C6 and r81-baseline.md C6 each already prescribe the exact cleanup (`git worktree remove …`) and describe the registration as deliberate-but-disposable. No report after round-81 re-checks either registration.

The frozen-tree evidence the r80/r81 reports describe is already unrecoverable from disk: the referenced `freeze/worktree-receipt.txt` (and the whole `corpus/live/r8{0,1}-baseline/` trees) are absent and were never tracked. The retained evidence is the tracked report text with sha256 digests (r80-baseline.md lines 122-125), which the prune does not touch.

EXECUTION FORM MATTERS (endorsing seat-52): a bare `git worktree prune` in game-dev-2d-shokunin removes all 5 registrations including the 3 wt-r9x pins. Use per-path `git worktree remove <path>` for the 2 unpinned gd2d targets, or lock the 3 pins first. In lore-shokunin a bare prune is safe (all 19 are candidates).

FLAG for the operator approval list: lore-shokunin is 3 commits ahead of origin/main with an untracked .scratch/, and game-dev-2d-shokunin is 6 ahead. The touch test is negative for all 21 registrations, so this does not block, but the r3 plan's lane-clean framing should be corrected to match the 12:38 census measurement.
